note: Wildmoot Tusk (unit identity, Wildmoot): zombified piglin, biped, hunched; boar-kin with a snout and big white tusks, a riveted leather cap under the team headband, a shaggy hide mantle, a spiked leather pauldron over a strapped jerkin, a barry team kilt, team forearm wraps, shin guards and hooves. The crossbarred boar spear stands over the cap. Tier II adds a bone brow plate, cap tusks, a bone left pauldron, a tooth necklace and skulls; tier III an ochre-lashed tusk crown, ochre bands and a grey pelt mantle. No back flag.
